banners.initialPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original panoramic forum header banner for Darknet Operator. Extra wide 4:1 landscape composition, intended for a shallow horizontal crop, keep every essential element in the central horizontal band. Reference image is only the style and palette guide; create a new scene. Hand-drawn 1990s science-fiction anime cel film aesthetic, confident ink outlines, restrained flat shadow shapes, matte painted setting, subtle analog grain, no photorealism or glossy 3D. Opaque edge-to-edge image. No text, typography, symbols, logo, watermark, faces, charts or UI. Scene: A lived-in orbital radio repair desk beside an observation window, faded coral and warm amber instrument lights, weathered dark olive equipment, a small emerald planetary limb far right. Friendly workshop atmosphere, no people. The left half is quiet dark charcoal for a forum title overlay.
banners.editPrompt: Edit target: image 1, the existing original forum banner. Style reference: image 2, the game's orbital wallpaper. Preserve the banner's palette, existing orbital setting, painted grain and inked 1990s anime cel treatment, and its extra-wide opaque landscape format. Change only the addition of a female character and the immediate foreground necessary to seat or stand her naturally. Add one original adult woman, about 30, copper-red short hair, faded olive work jacket and dark fully covered clothing, seated at the right-hand radio desk, calm welcoming expression, hands naturally near the radio. Keep the left half dark and empty. Important shallow-banner crop safety: the woman's head including hair must fit entirely in the central 40 percent of image height (between y=30% and y=70%), with her face centered vertically at y=50%, so she remains identifiable when the image is cropped into a wide forum header. Keep her head relatively small in the overall panorama, not a huge portrait. No text, logo, watermark, sexualized pose, photorealism or glossy 3D.
